title: wholesome kenyan citrusy-potatoes hash
description: a lacto-vegetarian-friendly kenyan dish featuring matcha and beurre monte that's perfect for a lazy sunday morning.

ingredients.name: diced potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and chopped into 1 inch cubes

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute, until fragrant.
add the diced potatoes and sauté for about 5 minutes, until they start to brown.
sprinkle the matcha powder over the potatoes and stir to combine.
add the lemon juice, orange juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
use a spatula to roughly break up the potatoes into smaller clumps, then stir in the beurre monte until the potatoes are well coated.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.

note: to make beurre monte, melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over low heat, then whisk in 2 tablespoons of heavy cream. continue whisking until the mixture thickens and comes away from the sides of the pan, then remove from heat and set aside.
